# Kathryn Cole

# Kathryn Cole

# Northside Elementary School Librarian

![](/media/uploads/2025/12/cole.jpg)

- **[Kathryn Cole](https://www.facebook.com/p/Kathryn-Cole-2729155/): Northside Elementary School Librarian **
- Cole is a social justice warrior who promotes LGBT books including **[over a dozen](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/a9ff2604-df9c-4ff5-9c9a-ab831457d7ad/CHCCS-Northside-ES-trans-books.png)** at Northside that teach about how a child becomes transgender. Here are excerpts from one of those books, *I am Jazz*:
- “I have a girl brain and a boy body”
- “sometimes my parents let me wear my sister’s dresses around the house”
- “one amazing day…mom and dad took me to meet a new doctor”
- “he spoke to my parents and I heard the word ‘transgender’ for the very first time.”
- “Mom and Dad told me I could start wearing girls’ clothes to school…they even let me change my name to Jazz.”

- In a **[video message](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/2729a9b1-9fd2-4932-8b3b-a5206fde8a8c/Carrboro-Kathryn-Cole-Sparkle-Boy.png)** in January 2026 to her students, Cole promotes the book “Sparkle Boy.” The book promotes transgenderism to young children.
